data.name: Dindyal
data.gender_notes: Dindyal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dindyal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dharma' which means righteousness, duty, or law. This name is believed to be given to those who uphold and follow the path of dharma, ensuring harmony and balance in the universe. The name Dindyal carries the meaning “God of Dharma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dindyal usually hope their child will grow to embody god of dharma and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dindyal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Dharma.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dindyal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
